name: barbell weightlifting complex
description: A flowing series of barbell lifts done back to back without putting the bar down. It works your whole body and your conditioning.
instructions: Load a light to moderate barbell and stand over it with feet hip width apart.
Perform the first lift of your chosen sequence, such as a deadlift.
Move straight into the next lift without setting the bar down.
Keep each rep crisp with a braced core and a flat back.
Finish all lifts for one round, then lower the bar and rest before repeating.
